intro: Rezlak is a goblin entrepreneur and member of the Tinkers' Union stationed along the dusty roads of Durotar south of Orgrimmar. He hires traveling adventurers to salvage his missing supplies and clear out the harpies preying on his supply caravans.

p: Perched beside the canyon roads connecting Razor Hill to Orgrimmar, Rezlak represents the Tinkers' Union—a goblin syndicate focused on engineering, supply lines, and industrial pragmatism. Rezlak cares little for the factional tensions of Kalimdor so long as business runs smoothly. When the fierce Dustwind harpies raided his cargo caravans and made the supply routes unsafe, Rezlak stayed put, preferring to contract out the dangerous work of extermination and recovery to any passerby willing to turn a profit.
